Formations Of Contract Of Employment And Its
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is defined as the physical means employed by employees either to intensity the economic pressure meted on the employer or to ensure that the concerted stoppage of work is not undermined.
Picketing is defined as the physical means employed by employees either to intensity the economic pressure meted on the employer or to ensure that the concerted stoppage of work is not undermined.

Fill in the blank: ______ is a generic form used to represent concerted efforts which employees may take in order to exert pressure on the employer so as to persuade or compel him to accede to their demands or claims.

The phrase industrial action is a generic form used to represent concerted efforts which employees may take in order to exert pressure on the employer so as to persuade or compel him to accede to their demands or claims.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the bringing to an end of the employment relationship.
Termination or dismissal is the bringing to an end of the employment relationship.
Fill in the blank: ______ may be defined as the process of working out a modus operandi between two parties - employer and trade union organisations - in matters pertaining to both parties.
Collective bargaining may be defined as the process of working out a modus operandi between two parties - employer and trade union organisations - in matters pertaining to both parties.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the central element in the structure of labour law.
The contract of employment is the central element in the structure of labour law.
fib: ______ are those which the contractual parties have not expressed or made but which may yet form a part of their contract.
Implied terms are those which the contractual parties have not expressed or made but which may yet form a part of their contract.
______ is a termination of contract of employment in breach of the express or implied mode, for the determination of employment contract.
Wrongful dismissal is a termination of contract of employment in breach of the express or implied mode, for the determination of employment contract.
______ is regarded as part of his property which, like any other type of property is entitled to protection.
An employer's confidential information is regarded as part of his property which, like any other type of property is entitled to protection.
______ is concerned with the law regulating the affairs of an employee with that of the employer.
Labour law is concerned with the law regulating the affairs of an employee with that of the employer.
______ is the principle of law which establishes the rule that a plaintiff must seek his remedy within a time limit stipulated by law after which period his action will become statute barred.

Limitation of Action is the principle of law which establishes the rule that a plaintiff must seek his remedy within a time limit stipulated by law after which period his action will become statute barred.
______ is a rule of practice or evidence not a rule of law.
Res ipsa loquitur is a rule of practice or evidence not a rule of law.
